@Rajarshi Mukherjee I opened a PR to add github workflows (Statlib#17):

  • build and lint every PR
  • add releases and tags when the Lean version changes

I did not add CI steps to generate the doc or the tutorial because I don't know how it's done for now and I don't want to make your website disappear.

Once this PR is merged I propose to add statlib to https://leanprover-community.github.io/downstream-reports/ and add another workflow to get automatic Mathlib bump PRs.

A reason I have for doing all that is that I think I'll eventually want to import Statlib in the #Lean Machine Learning repository, and for that Statlib needs to be clean and updated :) (the subverso dependency of Statlib will probably cause issues, but we'll see about that later).
I added a workflow to automatically keep Mathlib up-to-date in Statlib#19
Thanks Remy! I have merged both, this is helpful.
Could you run the "Update Dependencies" github action manually to check if it works? You should have a button to run it on https://github.com/stat-lib/statlib/actions/workflows/update.yml
Thanks for this, it is running now.

It failed for the following reason:

pull request create failed: GraphQL: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests (createPullRequest)

There is a setting somewhere on the repository that you need to activate. Or it might be in the organization settings.

It's on the page settings/actions of the repository, at the bottom of the page (but if I remember correctly it might be greyed out if you did not also allow it in the settings/actions page of the org).
It works now :octopus:
Is there a way to run this set of linters locally?
